obligations.requirement: A Web target binds view, surface generation, metrics generation, device-pixel metrics and frame identity.
obligations.oracle: Portable Web host tests reject stale/lost generation and accept a fresh generation while preserving canonical scene identity.
obligations.acceptance: All generation transition assertions pass without mutating the prior accepted target.

obligations.requirement: The Web host and bridge contain no semantic scene traversal, POC compiler ownership or fixed global render state.
obligations.oracle: Review-owned source scan rejects SemanticDocument, SceneCompiler, RuntimeScene iteration, fixed 800x600 globals and React state in the production Web adapter.
obligations.acceptance: Scope/boundary scan passes over the exact result revision.

obligations.requirement: The Web target builds through the locked Emscripten/WebGL2 path and browser smoke records resize/DPR, surface loss/rebind, pointer bridge and presentation observations.
obligations.oracle: Web build and browser runner evidence; unavailable Web SDK/browser evidence is a blocking environment result, never a fake PASS.
obligations.acceptance: g3-web-release target and browser smoke produce valid evidence.
